FROM docker.io/library/node:24-bookworm-slim AS application-build

WORKDIR /build

COPY ./src /build/src
COPY ./ci-cd/scripts/sync-global-assets.sh /build/scripts/sync-global-assets.sh

RUN set -eux; \
    sh /build/scripts/sync-global-assets.sh; \
    for application in backend frontend; do \
        for shared_directory in components views router stores models composables; do \
            mkdir -p "/build/src/VueJS/${application}/src/${shared_directory}"; \
            cp -a \
                "/build/src/VueJS/common/src/${shared_directory}/." \
                "/build/src/VueJS/${application}/src/${shared_directory}/"; \
        done; \
        cd "/build/src/VueJS/${application}"; \
        npm ci; \
        npm run build; \
        rm -rf node_modules; \
    done; \
    mkdir -p /build/output/backend /build/output/frontend; \
    cp -a /build/src/VueJS/backend/dist/. /build/output/backend/; \
    cp -a /build/src/VueJS/frontend/dist/. /build/output/frontend/; \
    rm -rf \
        /build/src/VueJS \
        /build/src/tests \
        /build/src/vagrant \
        /build/src/vendor \
        /build/src/runtime \
        /root/.npm; \
    rm -f \
        /build/src/Vagrantfile \
        /build/src/codeception.yml \
        /build/src/init \
        /build/src/init.bat \
        /build/src/yii_test \
        /build/src/yii_test.bat


FROM docker.io/yiisoftware/yii2-php:8.2-apache

RUN set -eux; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends apache2-utils libpq-dev; \
    docker-php-ext-install pdo_pgsql pgsql; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=application-build /build/src/ /app/
COPY --from=application-build /build/output/backend/ /app/htdocs/administration/
COPY --from=application-build /build/output/frontend/ /app/htdocs/
COPY --from=application-build /build/scripts/sync-global-assets.sh /app/scripts/sync-global-assets.sh
COPY ./ci-cd/apache-config/000-default.conf /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf
COPY ./ci-cd/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh

RUN set -eux; \
    php -m | grep -qx pdo_pgsql; \
    php -m | grep -qx pgsql; \
    export COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/composer-cache; \
    composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction; \
    composer docs:openapi; \
    rm -rf "$COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR"; \
    mkdir -p \
        /app/htdocs/assets \
        /app/htdocs/administration/assets \
        /app/htdocs/uploads \
        /app/runtime/system-assets \
        /app/backend/runtime \
        /app/console/runtime \
        /app/frontend/runtime; \
    cp /app/assets/logo.png /app/htdocs/logo.png; \
    cp /app/assets/logo.png /app/htdocs/administration/logo.png; \
    cp /app/assets/favicon.ico /app/htdocs/favicon.ico; \
    cp /app/assets/favicon.ico /app/htdocs/administration/favicon.ico; \
    cp -a /app/backend/web/assets/. /app/htdocs/administration/assets/; \
    cp -a /app/frontend/web/assets/. /app/htdocs/assets/; \
    rm -f \
        /app/htdocs/index.html \
        /app/htdocs/administration/index.html; \
    cp /app/frontend/web/index.php /app/htdocs/index.php; \
    cp /app/backend/web/index.php /app/htdocs/administration/index.php; \
    a2enmod rewrite setenvif; \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh; \
    sed -i 's/\r$//' /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh

EXPOSE 80

ENTRYPOINT ["entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["apache2-foreground"]
